description: Independent shim burn-down lanes for multi-agent / multi-task. One lane per branch; acquire locks per agent-file-lock.mdc.
integrationGate: npm run verify:system:quick && npm run shim:baseline

facadeNaming.purpose: Cross-context import ports — not product rename, compat re-exports, or second implementations.

productTerms.explore: Map-first discovery shell (/explore) — still the product surface name.

codeOwners.src/explore: Explore projection implementation (only explore + list may import deeply).
codeOwners.src/discovery: Shared card/read models + import ports (discoveryPort*) + URL spine (discoverySession*).

filenamePattern.discoverySession*: URL browse session spine only — params, parsers, geo URL, discoverySession.ts barrel.
filenamePattern.suffixRules: After discoveryPortExplore|List, suffix names consumer concern — not explore module paths. No Discover*, Discovery*, or second Explore* in suffix. Prefer domain bundle (e.g. discoveryPortExploreHosting) over mirrors (…LinkedRideshareExplore).
filenamePattern.codemodW29: scripts/dev/rename-discovery-ports.mjs (one-time; do not re-run on clean tree).

notAllowed: Fat barrels (e.g. discoverySession.ts re-exporting React trees).
Duplicate APIs or legacy aliases kept 'for compat'.
Cross-context from '@/explore/*' or '@/list/*' in guarded roots (use port path).
Doc-only 'alignment' without guards + zero baseline violations.
facadeNaming.endState: Illegal cross-import metrics at 0; ports stay one-concern re-exports or fold wire into shared-types where appropriate.
